authorization: 用户确认等成本分布为后续基线，固定参数扩大容量/并发，新增独立母题和真实agent循环

known_parent_matrix.purpose: pressure generalization on known development workload; not new-parent evidence
known_parent_matrix.prefix_guard: Before reserving any generation validate each actual prompt cached-block count <= cell capacity; no silent truncation, compression, prompt padding or no-cache bypass.
known_parent_matrix.timing_rule: Fresh complete crossover per cell. Never pool prior legacy matrix or 24/3 means into new averages.
known_parent_matrix.host_recipe: Fresh real tool CPU/SMT/NUMA plan for 10 concurrent tasks; account aggregate memory and all runnable tool threads. Reusing three CPU groups without documenting contention is forbidden.
known_parent_matrix.failure_rule: Stop at first native/protocol/quality/resource/source violation, seal all affected ledgers; no replacement batches or posthoc threshold relaxation.

new_parent_agent_loops.definition: New analysis/decision intent and provenance review; a new seed, scale, wording, operation name, or task ID alone is not a new parent.
new_parent_agent_loops.independence_claim: Holdout from predictor training and workload/prompt tuning, after family-level exclusion review; no claim of independence from model pretraining or from shared libraries.
new_parent_agent_loops.freeze_before_model: Freeze input hashes, schema, parent/family split, checker/reference hashes, prompt/protocol, CPU controls and aggregate/per-ledger generation caps before first model test.
new_parent_agent_loops.reference_requirement: Independent solver/reference plus meaningful incorrect-answer and violated-constraint rejection tests; real bounded tool executions, no compute tool returning entire task plan.
new_parent_agent_loops.agent_choice: Model selects each next tool and its arguments from actual returned data. Host only validates capabilities, executes tool, preserves full history and checks finish.
loop_certificate: Model-generated decision before each call, linked to immutable backend request/output.
At least two substantive decisions separated by real feedback; at least one changed candidate/parameter/branch based on observed feedback.
Tool feedback consumed by the next actual tokenized prompt; action-output-call identifiers and hashes agree.
Observed repair/search/refinement trace and model stop decision with independently validated final answer.
not_loop_evidence: oracle next action or future request length in predictor
new_parent_agent_loops.no_forced_errors: Do not deliberately break correct output to force a loop. One-shot success stays successful, reports no iterative-loop evidence, is never replaced by a cherry-picked failure.

initial_agent_pilot.probe_required: Exact tokenizer and accumulated history must fit 32 cached blocks before launch; if not, preregister another geometry before timing, not after seeing JCT.
initial_agent_pilot.post_pilot_matrix: Freeze exact capacities/concurrency/task lists from reference/protocol/resource feasibility only; do not select by policy JCT.

new_parent_agent_loops.admission_rule: Only development groups used to debug protocol. After first final-test run, retain every failure and do not retrain, retune, replace task or rename it unseen.
new_parent_agent_loops.failure_reporting: Report all-task success/timeout/invalid answers separately; never compare successful-task-only JCT without success denominators.

common_controls.residency: Verified read-only model/runtime/input/system maps; trace full changed controller and child dependencies outside JCT; own tmpfs only.
common_controls.host_scope: Shared host; affinity is not exclusivity. Observe CPU/IO/memory PSI and GPU tenants; never modify other jobs/global page cache/THP.
common_controls.uniform_audit: Same shadow and instrumentation overhead for all policies, included in JCT.

reporting: paired cycle and parent/family JCT, makespan, descriptive tail and failure denominators
exact input/output token equality, actual reusable/prefill tokens and native prefill/decode times
prediction/control/shadow cost, pressure and legal-victim differences, shared-prefix subset
GBDT global_fallback_unseen_state vs unsupported-window LRU fallback separately
elapsed>1s resolution limit, loop depth, actual tool branches/feedback, queue/load covariates
all failures, sealed generation ledgers, source hashes, independently audited archive and GPU release
next_executable_step: Restore verified runtime; freeze a versioned capacity/concurrency runner and CPU/memory plan; full-controller trace then first 24/3 crossover; new-parent suite construction is a separate preflight gate.
